pages.title: Four Rocks, One Recipe
pages.text: Put four matching rocks in a 2×2 square to craft their mapped ore drop. The output item and quantity are derived from the source ore’s sampled loot; check JEI for the exact result.$(br2)The $(l:auram:rocks/catalyst)Rock Catalyst$(/l) performs the same four-rock conversion during pickup.

pages.title: Generated Recipes
pages.text: Auram loads $(thing)config/auram/rock_recipes.json$() and exposes its mappings as the built-in $(thing)auram_generated_recipes$() datapack.$(br2)On the first run, mappings may be calculated after packs load. If conversion recipes are missing, run $(thing)/reload$() once or restart. Mappings are refreshed on server start and data reload.
